summary: Iteration 53: Salesman Order System - All backend APIs (15/15 tests passed) and frontend features verified successfully.

catalog_api.details: Returns 202 items with stock_qty and price from inventory_items collection. Search filter works.

create_order_api.details: Creates order with items and remarks. Validates customer_name and items required. Returns order_id starting with SO-

get_orders_api.details: Returns orders list with status, search, date filters. Admin sees all orders.

edit_order_api.details: Edit allowed only when status=pending. Rejects edit after approval with clear error message.

status_transitions_api.details: All transitions work: pending->approved, approved->billed (requires invoice_number), pending->hold, hold->rejected

billed_requires_invoice.details: Returns error 'Invoice number required for billing' when invoice_number not provided

stats_api.details: Returns order counts and totals by status (pending, approved, billed, hold, rejected)

my_customers_api.details: Returns mapped customers for salesman based on salesman_master collection

beats_api.details: Save and retrieve beat plans with customer_name, day_of_week, frequency

frontend_orders_tab.details: Orders tab visible in Salesman page alongside Performance, Item-wise Sales, Manage Salesmen

frontend_admin_order_view.details: Shows stats cards (Pending/Approved/Billed/Hold/Rejected), status tabs, search, date filters

frontend_dispatch_online_orders.details: Shows approved/billed/hold orders from salesman orders. Displays invoice numbers for billed orders.

frontend_salesman_role.details: Role selector includes 'Salesman (Orders Only)' option alongside Employee and Dispatch

api_tests.GET /api/salesman-orders/catalog: PASS - Returns 202 items with stock_qty, price, unit, stock_group
api_tests.POST /api/salesman-orders/orders: PASS - Creates order with items and remarks
api_tests.POST /api/salesman-orders/orders (valida: PASS - Validates customer_name and items required
api_tests.PATCH /api/salesman-orders/orders/{id} (: PASS - Edit allowed for pending orders
api_tests.PATCH /api/salesman-orders/orders/{id}/s: PASS - Hold and reject transitions work

frontend_tests.salesman_page_orders_tab: PASS - Orders tab visible in Salesman Performance page
frontend_tests.admin_order_view_stats: PASS - Stats cards show Pending(2), Approved(1), Billed(2), Hold(0), Rejected(1)
frontend_tests.admin_order_view_tabs: PASS - Status tabs: Pending, Approved, Billed, Hold, Rejected, All, Beats
frontend_tests.admin_order_view_filters: PASS - Search input and date range filters present
frontend_tests.dispatch_online_orders_tab: PASS - Online Orders tab shows approved/billed orders
frontend_tests.profile_salesman_role: PASS - Role selector has 'Salesman (Orders Only)' option

critical_code_review_comments: All salesman order APIs properly implemented with tenant/company isolation
Edit blocking after approval works correctly with clear error message
Billed status requires invoice_number validation implemented
Frontend Orders tab properly integrated in SalesmanPerformance page
Online Orders tab in Dispatch shows approved/billed orders for dispatch workflow
Salesman role option added to employee creation form
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed orders during backend testing for status transition tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 53 verified complete Salesman Order System: (1) Catalog API returns 202 items with stock/price, (2) Order CRUD with items/remarks, (3) Edit blocked after approval, (4) Status transitions (pending->approved->billed requires invoice), (5) Stats API, (6) My-customers API, (7) Beat management. Frontend: Orders tab in Salesman page shows admin dashboard with stats/filters/tabs. Dispatch has Online Orders tab. Profile modal has Salesman role option. Login requires token injection via localStorage for automated testing (empty captcha_token bypasses reCAPTCHA).
